quote: Be moderate in thy sleep; for he who does not rise early does not get the benefit of the day; and remember, Sancho, diligence is the mother of good fortune, and indolence, its opposite, never yet attained the object of an honest ambition.
source: Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quixote, Part II, ch. 43 (Don Quixote, to Sancho Panza) (trans. John Ormsby, 1885)
